outcomes.outcome: the key is deployed to /etc/ssl/private/<prefix>.key, 0600, and it is the key of the deployed certificate
the bundle /etc/ssl/certs/<prefix>.<service>.bundle.crt is the certificate then its intermediate, 0644, and the certificate verifies against that intermediate
the service is restarted once when the key or certificate changes
Let's Encrypt material (<prefix>-key.pem into the private directory, <prefix>.pem then <prefix>-chain.pem into <prefix>.<service>.bundle.pem)

uncovered.why: a fixture variant (letsencrypt_certificate true); one set holds one fixture, and no check set in this repository checks these file names or their order; the lab's test PKI already provides the -key.pem, .pem and -chain.pem files

outcomes.outcome: on RedHat the key goes to /etc/pki/tls/private

uncovered.why: the RedHat branch; this set runs on the plan's Ubuntu node
